metrics.label: Total population
metrics.desc: Resident + non-resident headcount per hex8. Calibrated to SingStat Jun-2024 (6.04M nationally).

metrics.label: Non-resident share
metrics.desc: Fraction of population that is non-resident (work-permit, dorm, FDW, students). High in industrial/CBD.

metrics.label: Dorm workers
metrics.desc: Migrant-worker dormitory population placed at real MOM dorm locations (439,198 nationally, DASL H2-2024).

metrics.label: Night lights 2024
metrics.desc: VIIRS night-light radiance 2024 — proxy for built/economic intensity.

metrics.label: Night-light growth
metrics.desc: % change in night lights 2022->2024. Positive = brightening (growth corridor).

metrics.label: Commercial activity
metrics.desc: NEW footfall-weighted economic-activity index: night lights + spend proxy + transit taps + place density + OD throughput. Distinct from supply-only commercial_intensity (corr 0.84).

metrics.label: Commercial intensity (supply)
metrics.desc: Supply/morphology composite: commercial place mix + commercial night-light + commercial land-use share.

metrics.label: OD throughput
metrics.desc: Total transit journeys originating + terminating in this hex (LTA DataMall OD, Apr-2026 weekday monthly). Bus+train, 100% mapped.

metrics.label: OD net flow (in-out)
metrics.desc: Inbound minus outbound journeys. Positive = net destination (job/retail magnet); negative = net origin (residential).

metrics.label: Day-night breathing
metrics.desc: EMERGENT: z(OD inflow) - z(resident pop). High = fills by day, empties at night (job center). Low = empties by day (bedroom community).

metrics.label: Latent retail demand
metrics.desc: EMERGENT: z(commercial activity) - z(commercial supply). High = high footfall but under-built retail (opportunity).

metrics.label: Transit access
metrics.desc: Composite transit accessibility (MRT/LRT/bus proximity + frequency).

metrics.label: Walkability
metrics.desc: Pedestrian-infrastructure + amenity walk-distance composite.

metrics.label: Vibrancy
metrics.desc: Places + magnets + reviews + transit + night lights.

metrics.label: Livability
metrics.desc: Walkability + green + amenities + transit (note: stale vs current parks layer).

metrics.label: Density pressure
metrics.desc: Population + buildings + low road space.

metrics.label: Persona affluence
metrics.desc: NVIDIA Nemotron persona affluence proxy (university + professional/manager + finance/infocomm). PA-resolution broadcast.

metrics.label: Persona median age
metrics.desc: Median age of adult personas in this planning area (NVIDIA Nemotron, PA-resolution).

metrics.label: % university-educated
metrics.desc: Share of personas with a university degree (PA-resolution).

metrics.label: HDB resale 4-room $/sqm
metrics.desc: Median 4-room HDB resale price per sqm (227k transactions, town-broadcast).
